title: [followups-800] Review follow-ups from harvest #800 — epic

labels.name: followups:issue
labels.description: Review follow-ups: created by triage from harvested findings

body:
This batch fixes the review findings verified as `valid` from harvest issue #800, one draft per code area: test-hygiene fixes, a small correctness bug in relation-property invalidation, a missing locked_at guard in a health-report query, weak or vacuous test assertions across five services, a wrong field-extraction path for union-schema validation errors, two doc/wording fixes, and two dead-code removals. Each draft is scoped narrowly to just the finding(s) it covers.

## Decisions
- Clustering: findings sharing a file or an immediately adjacent test/source pair (same pull request, same code area) were grouped into one draft each; findings in unrelated files were kept as their own single-finding drafts rather than bundled with unrelated fixes, per one-mechanism-per-draft.
- pr393's `.bb/AGENTS.md` draft and pr434's `apnsAdapter.unit.test.ts` draft are each `Blocked by:` an existing open issue (#653, #703 respectively) because that issue already touches the same file without naming a narrow region, and both could otherwise be dispatched concurrently and collide.
- pr429's `databasesHandler.test.ts` finding (10b6aa62c3) is grouped with its actual root cause in `genericBinding.ts` rather than left as a test-only fix, since the test's weak assertion is a symptom of the underlying field-extraction bug, not a separate defect.
- Seven findings verified `already-fixed` (pr395 90a77be3e4, pr397 bb8281cb53, pr397 adf58ef786, pr399 aeb5a19816, pr399 c878a00789, pr421 55275eebca, pr446 ca24a188f3) are rejected: each defect no longer holds in the code at develop HEAD, evidenced by the commit that fixed it.
- One finding (pr442 9f5ee92f21) is rejected as `invalid`: the finding claims TRASH_PURGE has no equivalent test, but the same pull request that introduced it also added an assertion covering it.

This batch's source is harvest issue #800. Closing this epic retires no finding — a finding's disposition is fixed by its own issue (or by this epic's rejection list), not by the epic's open/closed state.
